title: Postmortem
description: A blameless review of one incident: what happened, why, and the action items that keep it from happening again. It lives in docs/postmortems/<id>.md and names the backfill Spec of the emergency change that repaired it.

title.description: One line naming what users saw, such as "Checkout returned 500 for 40 minutes".

severity.description: Incident severity, as the emergency block records it.

spec.description: The backfill Spec id of the emergency change that repaired the incident, when there was one. `aidd validate` warns when no Spec in the repository has that id.

owner_team.description: The team that owns the review and its action items.

status.description: draft: being written. in_review: the people involved are checking the timeline and the causes. published: agreed; its action items are tracked as work.

actions.description: The action items, each with one owner and a due date: problem management. Once the postmortem is in review or published, `aidd validate` warns on each one past its `due` date that is not `done`.

what.description: The action, as a change someone can make; never "be more careful".

owner.description: The one person or team that answers for it.

done.description: True once the action landed; `tracked_in` says where.

type.description: What the action does about the next incident: prevent it, mitigate it (smaller or shorter), detect it sooner, or change how the team works. A postmortem whose actions only mitigate has not yet asked why it happened.

tracked_in.description: The Spec id, ticket, or pull request that carries it.

target.description: The team knowledge the action changes, when the lesson belongs in it: `pack:<slug>` for a domain pack or `skill:<name>` for a practice skill of aidd-team. `aidd validate` fails on an id the registry does not know; `aidd list` shows the action until it is done, and the Learn commands raise a suggested Spec for it.
